**What:** a revised `assets/img/tile.png` whose cell edges can clearly be seen on the board.

**Why:** brief R2 asks for the snake to move on a *visible* grid, and R9 for a legible play field. QA measured the build-1 tile edges at about rgb(17,25,49) on a rgb(11,17,33) fill, roughly 1.1:1 contrast (world/qa#3; repro in world/game-developer#4; screenshot `qa/evidence-build-1/long-game.png` at qa fd83a060886f0b279a430fd743b9ae933dee28f1). The snake, food and wall must still stand out clearly from the board, and the board should stay subordinate to them; keep the neon-on-dark style. Keep the size (32x32) and the file name so the loader needs no change. Update `assets/README.md` if it describes the tile.

**Waiting on it:** the release. After your push I'll re-check the assembled delivery, publish build-2 and have it re-played. I'm also telling game-developer here so the grid isn't changed in code as well.

comments.author: game-developer
comments.body:
Answered by integrating your pushed set (`67a4583`) as is, rather than asking for renames. Pushed in `0b856b85` and published as release **v0.1.0** (zip includes your `assets/`).

1. **Grid / canvas:** a 20x20 playing field at 32 px cells, with one ring of `wall.png` cells around it, so the canvas is 704x704 (22x22 cells), scaled by CSS with pixelated scaling. HUD (score / best) is HTML text above the board; title, pause and game-over are HTML overlays.
2. **Sprites:** PNGs, used as you described. `snake_head.png` is rotated to the heading. `snake_body.png` and `snake_body_alt.png` alternate by index and are **not** rotated, so the highlight stays top-left. `tile.png` is drawn on every field cell. `logo.png` replaces the "SNAKE" heading on the title, and `gameover.png` replaces the heading on game over. Cause, final score and Play again are text in `#e8f0ff`, with the score in `#7dffb2`. The CSS palette is your manifest's palette.
3. **Constraints:** keep the filenames and sizes as in your `assets/README.md`. The authoritative list of what the game loads is `docs/assets.md`. Every listed file must exist under `assets/` at the delivery root. If one is missing, the game draws a fallback shape and logs a console warning.
4. **Screens with art:** title (logo), play (tiles, wall, snake, food), game over (banner). Sounds: `start.wav` on Start/Play again, `eat.wav` on food, `turn.wav` on each accepted turn, `gameover.wav` on collision. Audio only plays after the first key press or click.

Checked on revision `0b856b85` plus your `67a4583`, in headless Chromium with real key presses (`checks/run_checks.py`): 28/28 pass, including "all assets load (no failed requests)". Screens: `checks/out/01-title.png`, `03-after-eating.png`, `05-gameover-wall.png`. I have no changes to ask for. If you revise the art, keep the names and I'll pick it up.

comments.author: playtester
comments.body:
Playtest of release build-1 (game-developer 7c1966c, artist 67a4583) is done and pushed in my repo at daa2370: `reports/build-1.md`, screenshots and `full-session.webm` in `evidence/build-1/`, replayable script `evidence/build-1/play.py`.

Played over file:// in headless Chromium 1366x768 with real arrow-key presses. Result: playable from title to game over and play again, and I found no defect against R1–R9.
- R2/R3: steady 120 ms steps; reverse press ignored; Up+Left pressed together both applied, no self-reversal; no page scroll.
- R4: food gave +1 length and +1 point each time (3→6 and 3→13), score updated at once, food never under the snake.
- R5: wall death and self death both ended the game, each with a clear cause line.
- R6/R8: title shows name, instructions and Start; game over shows the final score (10 matched) and Play again. I played again three times without reloading (Enter, click, Space): each started with score 0, length 3, a fresh position and new food.
- R9: legible and consistent, and it fits 1366x657, 1280x600 and 1024x600 without scrolling.

Minor notes, not failures: an arrow key does not start the game from the title (only Enter/Space/button); the board is dimmed heavily behind the overlays. I could not hear the audio (headless): the sound files loaded with no console errors, but quality is unchecked. Chromium only; I did not play to a full-board win. Closing.

comments.author: qa
comments.body:
QA report for build-1 (game-developer 7c1966c588b8, artist 67a4583812e38b740765f4920b0e1485b7903382; the assembled delivery from `ht-role delivery`). Script and results: `qa/check.py`, `qa/report-build-1.json`, `qa/evidence-build-1/*.png` in world/qa at fd83a060886f0b279a430fd743b9ae933dee28f1. Method: my own Playwright/Chromium script, game opened from file://, real key presses, plus rule-level checks on SnakeGame. I did not re-run game-developer's checks. 27/27 checks pass (one first-run failure was my own start-up sample; I fixed the script).

Verdict per requirement (all observed):
- R1 PASS: loads from file://, no console errors, no network requests.
- R2 PASS with a note: one cell per step, steady ~117 ms steps (tick 120), keeps moving without input. The grid lines are almost invisible (about 1.1:1 contrast) — low-severity defect, reported to game-developer for relay to the artist because I cannot reach the artist directly (world/game-developer issue just opened). Not blocking.
- R3 PASS: direct reverse is ignored; Up+Left pressed within one step both apply; Up+Down within one step does not kill; arrow keys do not scroll the page (600x300 viewport).
- R4 PASS: a bot played a 60-point game with real key events. Checked every frame: length == 3+score, food never on the snake, body contiguous with no overlap, HUD score == game score, no score jumps. Food never on the snake in 300 spawn trials on a nearly full board; filling the board gives a win.
- R5 PASS: the wall ends the game; a 2x2 loop self-collision ends it in the UI; the tail-cell rule behaves correctly (moving into the cell the tail leaves is safe; eating onto the tail cell is a collision).
- R6 PASS: the title is shown on load with the name, arrow-key instructions, a Start button and Enter/Space. The snake does not move before start.
- R7 PASS: the score is visible during play and equals the game score every frame.
- R8 PASS: the game-over screen shows the final score and a Play again button plus Enter/Space. Play again via click, Space and Enter, repeated three times without reloading, each time gave score 0, length 3, head at (10,10), heading right, new food.
- R9 PASS: no scrolling at 1366x768, 1280x600, 1024x600, 1440x700, 800x600 or 1366x625; screens are legible and consistent (screenshots).

Minor observations, not defects against R1–R9: the "Best" HUD value updates only at game over (it shows 0 during a 60-point game); an arrow key does not start the game from the title (the brief says "e.g."). Extras that behave: P/Esc pause and resume.

Not covered: audio playback (headless), real-timing behaviour on slow machines, boards larger than the 20x20 grid.
